entries.name: Tyler Goodson
entries.summary: Cowboys executive vice president Stephen Jones said Monday that Goodson is expected to miss time after injuring his knee in Sunday's 27-23 win over the Colts, Nick Harris of the Fort Worth Star-Telegram reports.

entries.name: Bo Melton
entries.summary: Melton exited Sunday's game against the Patriots and is being evaluated for a concussion.

entries.name: Drew Lock
entries.summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Lock's tests on his oblique injury were "good," and the issue is something the QB is expected to manage ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders,  Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

entries.name: Gardner Minshew II
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: J.J. McCarthy
entries.summary: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said Monday that McCarthy is managing a hip pointer but is expected to play Thursday against the Commanders, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports. "It does look like he's gonna play," Harbaugh said. "I feel fairly good about it."

entries.name: Jaylen Waddle
entries.summary: Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

entries.name: Jonathan Mingo
entries.summary: Mingo (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's matchup against the Colts, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

entries.name: Justin Herbert
entries.summary: Herbert sustained a left middle finger injury in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey was active but didn't play any snaps in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans after experiencing back spasms during pregame workouts, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Luther Burden III
entries.summary: Burden has a concussion, head coach Ben Johnson revealed after Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Malik Willis
entries.summary: Willis completed 13 of 25 passes for 128 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and added two rushes for seven yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

entries.name: Mo Alie-Cox
entries.summary: Alie-Cox is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Dallas due to a groin injury.

entries.name: Patrick Mahomes
entries.summary: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Monday that Mahomes (elbow) is considered day-to-day as this Sunday's game against the Falcons approaches, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Nacua suffered a knee injury during Sunday's 20-13 win at Washington and will undergo an MRI on Monday to determine its extent, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
entries.summary: Coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that the Patriots are awaiting MRI results on Stevenson's knee, Mark Daniels of MassLive.com reports.

entries.name: Will Kacmarek
entries.summary: Kacmarek is dealing with a quad injury and is questionable to return to Sunday's clash against Detroit.

entries.name: Xavier Worthy
entries.summary: Coach Andy Reid said Monday that Worthy (hamstring) is considered day-to-day in advance of Sunday's game against the Falcons, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.

entries.name: Adam Randall
entries.summary: Randall (neck) is officially listed as questionable for Thursday's game versus the Jaguars, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: When asked Wednesday when Pierce (heel) might be able to return to practice, Colts head coach Shane Steichen noted that he "can't put a timetable on it right now," Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Head coach Zac Taylor said Monday that Iosivas is doing well in his recovery from left thumb surgery, and the Bengals will "continue to work through this week" to determine when the receiver might return from injured reserve, Laurel Pfahler of the Dayton Daily News reports.

entries.name: Chris Brooks
entries.summary: As Week 10 approaches, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com indicates that Brooks (ankle) could be ready to return from IR.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: The 49ers placed Kirk (knee) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: David Njoku
entries.summary: Njoku (fibula) wasn't activated from IR-designated to return ahead of Sunday's game against the Texans, per the NFL's official transaction log.

entries.name: Dean Connors
entries.summary: Connors (hand) was placed on IR on Tuesday, Blaine Grisak of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Dyami Brown
entries.summary: The Commanders placed Brown (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Erick All Jr.
entries.summary: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor confirmed Wednesday that All has been diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee and will require season-ending surgery, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Isiah Pacheco
entries.summary: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Tuesday that Conner (foot) won't return from IR this week, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Noel
entries.summary: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: Arizona placed Love (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Jeremy McNichols
entries.summary: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Coach Dave Canales said Monday that the Panthers will spend the next two days discussing the status of Brooks (core), Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Kendrick Bourne
entries.summary: Arizona placed Bourne (tibia) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: Jackson, who is scheduled to undergo surgery on his injured right thumb, has told teammates he plans to return later this season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Coach Sean McVay noted Sunday that Ferguson pulled his hamstring during Friday's practice and will likely be sidelined for another couple of weeks, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
entries.summary: Head coach Kellen Moore said Wednesday that the Saints haven't opened Etienne's (hamstring) practice window just yet, Jeff Nowak of WWL Louisiana reports.

entries.name: Tyler Huntley
entries.summary: Huntley (toe) was placed on injured reserve Thursday.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Legette (knee) will be designated for return from injured reserve this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Zavier Scott
entries.summary: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.
